title: Terraform Registry Module & Provider Lookup Input

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: One or more Terraform modules to look up, each as "namespace/name/provider", e.g. "terraform-aws-modules/vpc/aws".

providers.title: Providers
providers.description: One or more Terraform providers to look up, each as "namespace/name", e.g. "hashicorp/aws". Leave empty to skip provider lookups.
